summary: Areas on a map, each in its tone: its inside a light wash of the tone, diagonal lines in it or nothing, inside a solid or a dashed edge, and its label written at its middle. The zone under the pointer deepens; the selected zone is edged in the selection color. With glow, a soft blurred line in each zone's tone stands just outside its edge.

anatomy.fill: solid: the tone at 0.18 of full, 0.24 under the pointer, 0.3 selected. hatched: diagonal lines in the tone, 1 wide every 6, rising to the right, on nothing, at 0.7 of full, 0.95 under the pointer, full selected. none: nothing, though the inside still answers the pointer.
anatomy.edge: Round the zone and its holes, 1.5 wide in the tone, 2 under the pointer, 2.5 selected in map-selection over a 5 wide halo in card; dashed 3 on 2 when the edge is dashed.
anatomy.label: The zone's label at the middle of its area (of its largest part's), centered on it: text.2xs at 500 on card at 80 percent, padded 4 across, rounded by radius-mini. A label that would cover another zone's is left out; the selected zone's never is, and is placed first, on card, ringed 1 in map-selection.
anatomy.glow: With glow, under the edge: a line round the zone 10 wide, blurred 8, moved 5 outward (to the side of the outline away from the inside, read from the way its outer ring runs), round-joined and round-capped, in the tone at 0.55 of full. Not animated.

zones.does: Each zone { id, area, tone?, fill?, edge?, label? }: the area an outline of positions (longitude, latitude) or a polygon or multipolygon, holes included. Plain unless given. The tone is friend, hostile, neutral, unknown or pending, drawn in that track affiliation's token (track-friend and the rest), or plain, drawn in muted-foreground.

fill.does: How each zone's inside is drawn unless the zone says.

edge.does: How each zone's edge is drawn unless the zone says.

labels.does: Writes each zone's label at its middle.

colors.does: Colors for the tones in place of their tokens.

opacity.does: How opaque the whole layer is.

interactive.does: Zones answer the pointer and presses; a press selects one as the map's selection.

glow.does: A soft glow in each zone's tone just outside its edge.

label.note: Centered on the zone's middle; text.2xs at 500, as its paint says.

edgeWidth.note: The edge at rest; 2 under the pointer, 2.5 selected.

hatchSpacing.note: How far apart the hatch's lines are, along the edge of its tile.

haloWidth.note: The selected zone's halo in card, under its edge.

glowWidth.note: The glow's width; it stands half that outside the edge.

hover.means: The pointer is over the zone: its inside deepens and its edge thickens.

selected.means: The map's selected zone: edged in the selection color over a halo, its label marked.
selected.reached: a press on it, or the map's selected

rest.note: In the zone's tone token; hatched and none as the anatomy says.
In the zone's tone token, blurred.

sokkel-ui: Drawn on maplibre: the zones as one GeoJSON source with style layers for each fill, the halo and each edge; the hatch is a pattern image made in code for each tone, in its resolved color.
Labels are written in the map's overlay at each zone's middle, projected again after every move, and only those in view.
zoneLegendEntry keys a zone's tone and fill in a MapLegend.

The glow is one more line layer on the zones' source, under the halo and the edges, with a line-offset of half its width signed by the outline's winding; without glow it is drawn at no opacity, which maplibre skips.
